response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior full-stack/systems engineer with broad language experience (DLang, C, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#, Java) and some low-level/embedded exposure, but his profile does not match this role's core requirements: no evidence of native-level Japanese, no demonstrated Linux kernel source modification experience, and no background in the specified security domains (MACsec, 802.1X, Captive Portal, tamper detection) or embedded LAN-switch networking. His recent work is almost entirely web/backend/full-stack, not embedded security firmware.
strengths: Deep, varied technical background across web, embedded, and systems programming (DLang, C, C++)
Strong track record of ownership, mentoring, and open-source project leadership
Demonstrated low-level/async programming experience (fibers, async I/O, high-performance systems) at Dunnhumby
concerns: No mention of Japanese language proficiency, which is a hard requirement
No evidence of Linux kernel investigation/modification experience
No experience with required security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, Captive Portal) or L2/L3 switch networking

key_factors.factor: No Linux kernel or embedded LAN-switch security experience
Strong general C/systems and embedded background
